issues: The law title is wrong. The official title, per the Benin Government Secretariat (sgg.gouv.bj) and the promulgated text in the National Assembly archive, is 'Loi n° 2009-09 du 22 mai 2009 portant protection des données à caractère personnel en République du Bénin'. It does not say 'portant organisation de la protection'. Both sources were checked and the wording is FOUND.

The regulator is misnamed and anachronistic for a 2009 record. The 2009 law created the Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés (CNIL). The Digital Code (Law 2017-20 of 20 April 2018) turned the CNIL into the APDP: Art. 645 refers to 'l'APDP (ex CNIL)'. The APDP's official name is 'Autorité de Protection des Données à caractère Personnel', not 'Autorité de Protection des Données Personnelles'.

The note 'Later absorbed into Benin's Digital Code' is loosely right but imprecise. Art. 647 of Law 2017-20 repeals 'toutes dispositions antérieures contraires', including those of Law 2009-09. The Code itself misdates that law as '24 mai 2009'. DLA Piper still lists both laws as governing the regime. The note should say the 2009 law was superseded in part, not absorbed.

Source[0] (DLA Piper): the quote is FOUND verbatim and supports the law number, the date (22 May 2009) and the 2017-20 Digital Code. DLA's English gloss of the title ('Dealing with the Protection of Personally Identifiable Information') is a translation, not the official French title.

issues: The law number and date are correct. Lei n.º 22/11 de 17 de Junho was published in Diário da República I Série n.º 114 on 17 June 2011 (lex.ao, FOUND). The law's own heading is 'LEI DA PROTECÇÃO DE DADOS PESSOAIS'.

The regulator is spelled 'Agência de Proteção de Dados' (Brazilian/post-reform orthography, copied from DLA Piper). The law and the agency itself (apd.ao) both use 'Agência de Protecção de Dados', which also matches the record's own law title ('Protecção'). This is a minor fix for consistency and accuracy.

The source date is misleading. The DLA Piper Angola page says 'This content was last reviewed in 2021 and may not reflect recent legislative updates', so its date should be 2021, not 2026. The content is still accurate: apd.ao continues to cite Lei n.º 22/11 in 2026, and a revision of the law was only at public consultation.
